answer: Got it — stored as a standing convention: library crates use `thiserror`, binaries use `anyhow`, never swapped. I'll apply this in future work on this codebase.

memories.content: In this codebase, library crates must use the thiserror crate for their error types, and binary crates must use the anyhow crate for error handling; using anyhow in libraries or thiserror in binaries is disallowed.
Mixing up thiserror and anyhow (i.e. using anyhow in a library crate or thiserror in a binary crate) has caused real problems twice in this codebase.
